Hi Liam — thanks for the note and the agenda. Really excited to meet the ops & informatics teams. One quick update on our end: Priya (your coordinator) mentioned earlier this week that a few of your engineers will be pulled into a field event that afternoon. Our SE (Aditya) is scheduled to travel the night before and could be delayed getting in.

To avoid an under-staffed session, would you be open to a small change: we can record a focused 35–40 minute walkthrough (tailored to the ops + informatics sections you highlighted) and deliver that recording to you by end of day Monday. Then we pick a 30-minute live Q&A window that fits the team either the same day after the table tour or the following morning. That way folks who must leave for the field event still get the core content, and the demo remains high quality.

If that sounds reasonable, Aditya and I will prepare a concise recording and a short one-page handout that maps timestamps to agenda items. I can also propose three 30-minute Q&A slots.

If you'd prefer we hold the full live session and risk partial attendance, we can do that too — just let us know.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Rep | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0163
